messages.subject: error with graph file
parts:
Hello,

I have created a graph file that shows the errors below after doing "inla.debug.graph". I have checked the individual nodes and I see no problems in the neighbor reciprocity between nodes.  "inla.read.graph" does not give me any message. I would appreciate your help about any potential issue. Here is the graph file attached for your information: https://www.dropbox.com/s/9f12oae60yvf5ns/zones.graph

Thanks in advance.

Victor.

On Mon, 2014-05-12 at 11:22 -0700, Víctor Hugo Gutiérrez Vélez wrote:
> Hello,
>
> I have created a graph file that shows the errors below after doing
> "inla.debug.graph". I have checked the individual nodes and I see no
> problems in the neighbor reciprocity between nodes. "inla.read.graph"
> does not give me any message. I would appreciate your help about any
> potential issue. Here is the graph file attached for your information:
> https://www.dropbox.com/s/9f12oae60yvf5ns/zones.graph

this is intricate... in short, it contains number in the scientific
format, like

4e+05

instead of

400000

and that confuse the io-system, since its read as text and converted
into integers, and then the confusion arise.

sorry about this. I'll see if I can fix this internally, but until then
you need to convert it.

H
